purpose: Check whether deposited demo protein coordinate annotations translate from the authenticated deposited DNA, without rerunning gene callers or changing sequences
selection_context: 0/25 exact regenerated protein multisets already observed; all2980 demo headers were inspected for format: code11 only; ATG/GTG/TTG and Edge starts. Seven partial headers observed. No CDS translation comparisons run before this specification.
scope: All25 pinned demo phage proteomes, all2980 deposited protein records, and the corresponding frozen regenerated proteomes. Not a host or infection evaluation.
rules: Use exactly the declared one-based inclusive start/end/strand; no shifts, alternative frames, trimming, sequence edits or searches for better matches.
Translate bacterial code11; reverse-complement minus-strand CDS. Require complete codons.
For a declared non-Edge ATG/GTG/TTG start, verify that codon and translate initiation as M; Edge retains its actual first translated codon.

Interpret partial flags as left/right genomic boundary flags; use strand to identify partial translation start/end. Check declared start/stop consistency and exact protein sequence including terminal stop where declared complete.
Preserve invalid/unsupported records as explicit failed checks, not invented corrections.
Compare deposited and regenerated start/end/strand coordinate sets and same-strand stop positions descriptively, retaining changed-start cases; never select new caller parameters from these results.
Count coordinates exceeding metadata genome length as representation diagnostics only, without declaring physical termini.
interpretation: Translation agreement supports sequence correspondence for the annotated intervals. It does not authenticate experimental stock identity, prove gene calling correct, establish the authors exact calling commands, or reproduce infection predictions.
